alt: A quiet residential street of mid-rise blocks lined with trees, with the curved city rising ahead under a bright artificial sky.
A lakeside park with a path to the water, low housing around it and the distant curved city beyond the far shore.
A cluster of crowned towers and spires with a lit landmark, seen across a park lawn at eye height.
A metro viaduct on tall portals crosses a broad tree-lined street, with the line running away along the road.
A raised plate district with balustrades and planters, an inhabited truss bridge and rows of blocks on the next plate.
Pale structural piers and ring beams rise through the mid levels of the city, with partial decks, bridges and bay infill.
A viaduct terrace on the end wall cliff, with a train on its track strip, planters and terraced blocks above the city.
An ascender cabin rises through the open floor of the artificial sky, with the curved city and a lit ceiling ahead.
From the first stretch of the climb, the neighbourhood below stays familiar while the horizon begins to curve upward.
Inside the panoramic ascender cabin, window seats, rails and a glass floor gallery face a live altitude and gravity display.
An ascender tower of four bronze-latticed blade trusses with cabins climbing and descending on three tracks toward the distant axis.
Racks of lettuce, basil and kale in four growth stages line a grow hall deck under LED rigs, with a harvest gantry overhead.
Totes of fresh greens travel a belt through a wash tunnel, an optical sorter and a weigher in the farm process wing.
Stacked crop galleries, nutrient vessels and robotic harvesters fill the upper city above the artificial sky.
A slender stationary spine runs through the centre of the rotor while the whole city turns around the viewer.
Inside the 120 m spine tube, ring lamps every 25 m frame the express guideway, crew galleries and four utility trunks.
A five-car express on its guideway inside the spine, seen from ahead of the head car with its destination board lit.
A transit bridge between two rotors, with window bands, X bracing and a lenticular lower truss, seen from its sunlit flank.
The open truss of the industrial rotor holds tank farms, cargo racks and gantries around a large empty volume.
The industrial rotor with the material flow overlay showing where lunar feedstock and asteroid volatiles are stored and move.
Four reaction rings sit in their housings along the momentum bay, with the stationary spine and industrial frame beyond.
A 700 m spacecraft floats unsupported inside a much larger construction volume of trusses and rings.
An open crew drum with its deck stack, capture arms, a manipulator and an inspection capsule at working range.
A propellant tank on approach with its mover, tension lines and crawlers beside the cradles of the tank bay.
The terminal nave seen down its 460 m length: ribbed walls, handline conveyors with riders, catch-net rings and gate signage.
Rotating comfort lounges turn on their stationary hubs beyond the windows of the terminal nave.
A freighter berthed at a long truss pier on the outer face of the port, with tugs and the axial aperture nearby.
Foil spheres and storable tanks of the propellant farm sit under sunshades with radiators and transfer lines, outside the station body.
The aft face of the station from 25 km, with its ribbed shield, red rim lights, central tower and four landing masts.
Four tall landing masts carry HVDC tethers that run aft toward the distant solar farm.
A black-start reactor on its tall mast sits behind a shadow shield with radiator petals edge-on to the Sun.
Through arched windows in the spine, rows of HVDC valve halls and capacitor banks fill the converter hall.
The whole station in space, a grey cylinder with a caged ring section, radiator banks and attached utilities.
Close on the hull: shielding cassettes, repair seams, maintenance rails and a launch trench.
A bank of radiator panels on pylons and a spine, seen from the hull side against the scale of the habitat.
A forward defence battery with armoured housing, reload magazine, interceptor cells and a blast wall.
A domed stone market hall behind a columned portico with a name board, across a plaza in the dense civic quarter of Noordung.
The front of Charter Hall: tall arched windows and a columned portico under a name board, with the towers of the quarter behind.
A columned portico with a pediment and a black name board on a street of stone civic frontages, with a resident on the steps.
A small waterfall drops from a stone lip into a plunge pool beside a grassed berm, with the curved city climbing the sky behind.
